scope.summary: Implement the export profile system per Section 13.26: typed BXP- profile rows for blender_gltf, blender_fbx_bridge, ue_fbx_bridge, ue_gltf, vrm, usd, and obj, each carrying an EXACT units/axis contract (ue_fbx_bridge: 1 unit = 1 cm, Z-up/X-forward; glTF lanes: meters, format-handled axes) plus per-profile knobs for influence caps, texture budgets, UV strategy, and morph-export rules (Part-3 contract, GREQ-004/010/039/040 fields).
acceptance_criteria: Seven BXP- profile rows seed on migration with stable ids (BXP-BLENDER-GLTF, BXP-BLENDER-FBX-BRIDGE, BXP-UE-FBX-BRIDGE, BXP-UE-GLTF, BXP-VRM, BXP-USD, BXP-OBJ); re-seeding is idempotent.

Each profile is a typed struct (schemars) with explicit unit scale, up-axis, forward-axis, handedness, influence cap, texture budget preset, UV strategy, morph-export-rules ref, and reference-pose policy; no free-form JSON blobs.

The ue_fbx_bridge profile asserts cm/Z-up/X-forward; blender_gltf asserts meters; a unit-contract test computes a known bone length through each profile's transform and matches the expected target-space value.
Profiles are versioned rows addressable by id via the REST/MCP surface; exports record which profile version produced them.
usd profile row exists but is gated on the usd-export feature (selecting it without the feature returns a typed disabled-lane error).
scope.risk_if_missed: Without per-target contracts every export lane degenerates into the Daz scale/orientation lottery (0.01 scale bugs, bone-orientation popups) that the Part-3 contract exists to kill.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Backend/solver scope: behavior is observable via TraceProjection, typed TAILOR_BODY_* receipts, and the 13.12 capture APIs; operator/model GUI exposure rides the BodyKit panes (13.27) and is validated there.

target_entries: Tailor UserManual > BodyKit publishing and DCC interchange

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: This MT owns authoritative, job, or external-tool lifecycle events and must project the same event_id, run_id, actor_id, and correlation_id from EventLedger into Flight Recorder.
This MT must wire the shared internal_diagnostics API for its native, job, device, solver-run, or DCC failure modes with bounded structured evidence.
Long-running, native, or external-process work must register bounded progress and child/process identity with the shared Palmistry watcher; Tailor must not fork a watcher.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.

required_changes_before_execution: Consume the signed technical refinement, canonical command/surface registries, classified HBR tiers, and task-oriented UserManual contract before execution.
